// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// declarations / modules / imports and exports
import type { User as ImportedUser } from "./user.ds" with { mode: "static" };
// <- keyword.declaration.import.ds

export default function run(): void {}
// <- keyword.declaration.import.ds

export { ImportedUser as User };
// <- keyword.declaration.import.ds

// declarations / modules / metadata and globals
module {
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
    const enabled = true;
}

global {
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
    const process: Process;
}
